title: Advancing the Robustness of Large Language Models through Self-Denoised Smoothing
reasoning: The paper includes a significant evaluation component focused on jailbreak attacks for human alignment. It specifically evaluates the model's adherence to ethical and safety guidelines by using a judge model (ChatGPT) to assess whether responses to harmful prompts in the AdvBench dataset constitute violations. This goes beyond a simple ethical considerations section and is a core part of the methodology's evaluation.
